description: Catch network mocks that drifted from the real API: finds route.fulfill JSON bodies (TS/JS and pytest specs) and routeFromHAR files, GETs each mocked endpoint on the live server (baseUrl) and reports fields the mock has that the API no longer sends, changed types, new nulls and endpoints that are gone. Only GET is sent; write mocks are listed, not replayed.

baseUrl.description: Live server for relative mock URLs, e.g. 'http://localhost:3000' or a staging URL (default: use.baseURL from the Playwright config)

filter.description: Only test files whose path contains this text

headers.description: Headers for the live calls, e.g. { Authorization: "Bearer {{env:E2E_API_TOKEN}}" }; {{env:NAME}} reads E2E_*/TEST_*/PW_* variables so tokens stay out of chat

urls.description: Real URLs for wildcard or regex mocks: { '**/api/items/*': '/api/items/1' }

name: check-mocks

fix.description: the replacement line, when the fix is mechanical

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Check mocks against the live API
